headline: TRUMP 🗣️ THREATENS To ANNIHILATE ☢️ IRAN 🇮🇷 At UN 🏛️
text:
In his UNGA 🏛️ speech 📢 Donald 🍊 Trump pondered 🤔 whether a peace 🕊️ deal 🤝 would be agreed ✅ or whether he would have to take extreme ⚡ action 🛠️ against Iran 🇮🇷 while officials 👥 from both countries met secretly 🤫 on the sidelines 🏟️!! A lone 🧍 Iranian delegate 👀 watched 😶 the whole thing unfold as the president dropped his massive 💥 ultimatum about possibly having to ANNIHILATE ☢️ the Islamic Republic if no deal materialized 🧨.

Before a packed 🥟 standing-room-only crowd 👥 Trump rejected 🌍 global government 🏛️ completely and vowed 🤝 to broker peace 🕊️ between Russia 🇷🇺 and Ukraine 🇺🇦 while making sure the US 🦅 wins the artificial intelligence 🧠 race 🏁!! He also touted his wins 🏆 on the economy 💰 immigration 🛂 border security 🛡️ and tackling violent crime 🛑 in remarks that sounded way more pitched 🎤 to November midterm voters 🗳️ than the diplomats sitting right there in Manhattan 🏙️.

The Donald 🍊 spent big chunks of the address justifying the war 🔥 with Iran 🇮🇷 which has spiked global oil prices 🛢️ and dragged his approval ratings 📉 down since the US and Israel launched military action 🪖 back in February ❄️!! His tone was pure COERCIVE 🔥 DIPLOMACY 💪 contrasting hard with UN Secretary General António Guterres who warned that global divisions 🕳️ were deepening and the world needed to remember interdependence 🤝 of all peoples 🌍.

Trump argued the conflict prevented Tehran from getting a nuclear weapon ☢️ and proved the value of his famous peace 🕊️ through strength 💪 approach using ultimatums instead of weak compromise 🤝!! He straight up asked the assembly "Will a deal 🤝 be made with Iran that lets them rebuild 🏗️ and create a far greater country than ever before or do I annihilate ☢️ the Islamic Republic and do it quickly never giving them a chance to kill and destroy people and countries again Do I drive them into hell 🔥🔥"

Later the absolute UNIT 🍊 told reporters that American officials had a very productive 🏭 three-hour meeting 🕒 with the Iranian delegation on the sidelines and that it went great 👍!! Iran state TV confirmed Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met US Special Envoy Steve Witkoff through a Qatari mediator 🕊️ who shuttled messages back and forth all day with Tehran demanding an end to the war on all fronts and to US acts of aggression 🛑.

Witkoff gave a big thumbs up 👍 when asked and later posted on X that the mediators kept working hard and the talks were constructive and promising 🌟!! In the same speech Trump predicted his genius diplomacy would end Russia's war in Ukraine 🇺🇦 faster than anyone thinks by working closely with both leaders and also rebranded artificial intelligence as super intelligence 🧠 because the word artificial sounds too fake ❌ while signing a fresh deal with Denmark 🇩🇰 and Greenland 🧊 to beef up US military bases there and reaffirm sovereignty with broad access granted.
